title: Market scouting: territory synthesis and buyer-voice mapping for model substitution risks
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Produce a prioritized map of customer-facing risks and opportunity zones where customers are likely to seek model substitution (open models, vendor switches, or in-house hosting). Deliverables: (1) Territory synthesis report (market segments by substitution sensitivity); (2) Buyer-voice matrix (decision criteria, trigger events, pricing/latency trade-offs); (3) Tactical playbook for rapid response (detected signal -> recommended Redwood action).

Scope: Focus on mid-market SaaS and two enterprise verticals (finance & healthcare) across NA and EU. Include signal sources: vendor price changes, new model releases, benchmark performance deltas, incident/uptime noise, regulatory notices (e.g., data residency), and sales desk win/loss notes.

Methodology: Combine quantitative signal ingest (usage telemetry, public model release feeds, open-source repo activity, pricing telemetry) and qualitative inputs (customer interviews, win/loss calls, AE surveys). Produce a taxonomy of substitution triggers and weight each by likelihood + downstream revenue exposure.

Success criteria: Complete territory synthesis and buyer-voice matrix with prioritized recommendations for 3 playbook actions; identify top 6 vendor/model signals to watch and provide signal-to-action mapping. Report accepted by GTM and Solutions Engineering and integrated into the weekly Model Watchtower digest.

Stakeholders: PM (owner), GTM research, Solutions Eng, Data Science (for signal weighting), Legal (for regulatory inputs).

Risks: Signal noise (false positives), incomplete telemetry from private deployments, and interview sample bias. Mitigations: conservative weighting, cross-validate with contract data, and run a small blinded evaluation of interview themes.

Focus first on mid-market SaaS and healthcare vertical; postpone retail/advertising vertical until next cycle.
Adopt a conservative alert threshold (top 5% of weighted signal score) for automated playbook triggers to avoid alert fatigue.
